fomod.Name: Bard Hero
fomod.Author: Mern
fomod.Description: Turns Skyrim's bard performances into a five-fret rhythm game. Equip a lute, flute or drum through Skyrim's Got Talent, pick a song, and play it - with a live highway, star power, streak scoring and a crowd that reacts to how you are actually doing. Optionally adds the Doom Lute, an electric guitar you forge at the Atronach Forge.
